label: Pet Story Short Vertical V1
description: 반려동물 일상 에피소드형 Shorts 포맷. owner-observed 행동 비트를 source로 잠그고, 9:16 세로 5-scene picture lock을 먼저 만든 뒤, 짧은 내레이션, SE, sparse typography를 후반에서 얹는다.

runnerHints.sourceStage: lock the observed pet story truth, room continuity, rights note, and safety rule before writing beats
runnerHints.basePrep: prepare a canonical pet reference pack and a vertical clean-base frame before keyframe work
runnerHints.keyframeGate: generate and review five keyframes before any video generation
runnerHints.pictureStage: generate five mute vertical clips with explicit continuous_handoff or transition_cut boundary rules
runnerHints.dubStage: lock picture first, then add sparse narration, optional inner monologue, music, and SFX
runnerHints.typeStage: apply sparse reaction-led typography only after dub lock

sceneGenerationPolicy.sceneStartRule: each scene declares an approved start frame; continuous_handoff scenes use the previous clip final frame as the next start seed, while transition_cut scenes use their own approved start frame
sceneGenerationPolicy.sceneBoundaryRule: each boundary declares boundaryMode. Use continuous_handoff for uninterrupted action continuity. Use transition_cut for intentional time, location, angle, scale, or emotional jumps and define transition type, duration, purpose, and audio/visual bridge.
sceneGenerationPolicy.sceneFrameRule: each scene should lock both a start frame and an end frame before motion generation
sceneGenerationPolicy.scenePoseTargetRule: approved keyframes define the target pose and expression for each scene block
sceneGenerationPolicy.defaultCompositionRule: pet stays dominant in frame, dining-space continuity stays readable, and food is visible without showing actual ingestion

scriptPolicy.defaultNarrationRule: prefer one short line or one reaction beat per scene; do not write a dialogue-heavy script
scriptPolicy.defaultEndingRule: the final line should support the innocent reaction payoff rather than explain the whole story

voiceConfigPolicy.rule: voice-slots may override ttsVoiceEnv, otherwise the workflow may use a narrator default or stay silent when the brief chooses a no-voice pass

audioPolicy.timingGuideRule: if narration script exists, estimate rough timing with a local/basic no-paid-API guide TTS or equivalent timing pass before final scene durations are locked
